```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 17_correlation_significance
title: >
  Significance Quiz
questions:
  - id: correlation_reject
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >
      If your correlation test statistic is t = 3.20 and the critical values are
      +/-3.18, can you reject the null hypothesis?
    options:
      - text: >
          Yes, barely
        correct: true
      - text: >
          No, because t must be negative
      - text: >
          No, because 3.20 is less than 3.18
      - text: >
          Cannot tell because t is never used for correlation
    explanation: >
      The obtained t is just beyond the positive critical value.
```
